Funds will be used for speech and language therapy for pre-school children and disaster relief. You must present a current dues card from the Grand Lodge of Ancient Free Masons to be eligible for this plate.

plates.name: Anderson University

The vehicle is to be used in club activities, exhibits, tours, parades and similar events, but cannot be used for general transportation. When the vehicle is sold, junked, or otherwise disposed of, you must return the antique plate to an SCDMV branch. The plate costs $10.

plates.name: Disabled Female Veteran
plates.notes: This license plate is available to people who submit proper certification from the Veterans Administration. In addition to this certification, you must complete the Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37) and provide a letter or other documentation from the US, Regional, or County Veterans Administration certifying that you are a war time disabled veteran who is entitled to compensation for the loss of use of one or both legs or arms, has a permanent impairment of vision in both eyes to a degree as to constitute virtual blindness and is entitled to a special monthly statutory award by reason thereof, or is a South Carolina veteran classified as totally and permanently disabled due to service-connected disabilities as determined from the medical records on file with the county or US Department of Veterans Affairs. To receive handicapped privileges you must be certified permanently handicapped by a licensed physician on the Disabled License Plate and Placard Application (SCDMV Form RG-007A). There is no fee for this plate. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Disabled Veteran, Disabled Veteran Handicapped, and Disabled Veteran Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Disabled Plates
plates.notes: Disabled plates are available at any SCDMV branch. You must submit a Disabled License Plate and Placard Application (SCDMV Form RG-007A) with Section 4 Physician's Statement completed by a licensed physician. If you own a vehicle that has a license plate for a person with a disability, you must have the registration card that lists the names of all eligible people with a disability who can drive or be carried in that vehicle. When you renew your plate for a person with a disability, you will receive a new plate and registration. Plates for people who have a disability who drive motorcycles are also available. Businesses are not required to certify with a physician. However, businesses with plates for people with disabilities must carry registration cards. Business certificates will not list names of people with disabilities, but the certificate will indicate that the vehicle is entitled to park in designated parking spaces. The fee for the plate is $36 every two years. Truck fees are determined by weight of truck. Vehicles that have this plate are exempt from the payment of municipal parking meter fees (SC Code Section 56-3-1965) and are permitted to park in designated handicapped parking spaces.

plates.name: Disabled Veteran

Proceeds from this plate will support the construction of the Dr. Mary McLeod Bethune museum, restaurant, and nature trail and support tourism in Mayesville, Sumter, and South Carolina.

plates.name: Driven By The Arts
plates.notes: Driven by the Arts license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $60, goes to schools and communities across the state for K-12 arts education programs. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Drivers For a Cure
plates.notes: The Drivers For a Cure license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost is $30 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. Proceeds from the plate will be evenly split with MUSC Hollings Cancer Center and Duke Cancer Institute and used to support cancer research. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Ducks Unlimited
plates.notes: The Ducks Unlimited license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected are distributed to the South Carolina Ducks Unlimited State Committee for wetlands conservation projects in the state. The fee for this plate is $50 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Eagle Scouts of America
plates.notes: The Eagle Scouts of America license plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. The plate is available to South Carolina residents who have been awarded the Eagle Scout Award. You must provide documentation that you received the Eagle Scout Award. A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to the SC Indian Waters Council, Boy Scouts of America, and five other Boy Scout Councils.

plates.name: East Carolina University
plates.notes: East Carolina University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. This plate is available through the mail and online.

plates.name: Emergency Medical Services
plates.notes: The fee for the Emergency Medical Services license plate is $30 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will be used to improve emergency medical services throughout South Carolina.

plates.name: Emergency Medical Technician
plates.notes: First-time applications must be handled by mail. You may only receive one of these license plates. You must hold a valid EMT certificate issued by the South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Services, Division of Emergency Services. The fee is $30 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: Endangered Species
plates.notes: Fees collected, in addition to the registration fees, will be deposited into a Nongame Wildlife and Natural Areas Fund. The fee for this plate is $30 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: Erskine College
plates.notes: Erskine College license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Farm Vehicle
plates.notes: Having this license plates mean the vehicle is used exclusively for agricultural, horticultural, and dairy operations or livestock and poultry raising. If the farm vehicle has an empty weight of less than 7,500 pounds it may be used for general and domestic purpose but cannot be used for hire. The fee is determined by weight.

plates.name: Female Veteran
plates.notes: The Female Veteran license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served in the United States Armed Forces active or reserved components. To apply for the plate, you must present your Department of Defense Form DD-214, indicating that you were honorably discharged, along with a completed Application for Military Plate (MV-37). Only three plates within the Female Veteran plate class to include Female Veteran, Female Veteran Motorcycle and Female Veteran Wheelchair may be issued to vehicles registered in your name. The cost for this plate is the regular registration fee. This Plate is available by mail only. To receive the handicapped privileges , you must be certified permanently handicapped by a licensed physician on the Disabled License Plate and Placard Application (SCDMV Form RG-007A).

plates.name: Firefighter
plates.notes: First-time applications must be handled by mail. A portion of the fees collected for this plate (based on the total number sold) goes to the South Carolina Fire Academy. You must certify that you are an active or retired member of a fire department on the application. Your Chief Officer of the Fire Unit must sign the application. The fee is $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: First in Golf
plates.notes: This license plate recognizes South Carolina as having been the number one golf destination in the United States. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Proceeds from this plate are distributed to the SC Junior Golf Association to fund its many programs such as scholarships and free golf instruction for minority and underprivileged children. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $70 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: Florida State University
plates.notes: The Florida State University license plate is sponsored by the Florida State University Alumni Association. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Proceeds from the plate will be used for scholarships. You must submit a completed Application for Special License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees. You may buy this plate online or in person and the plate will be mailed to you.

plates.name: Forestry Association of South Carolina
plates.notes: This plate is available to all SC residents. The fee for this plate is $10 in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Francis Marion University
plates.notes: Francis Marion University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, will be sent to school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Fraternal Order of Police
plates.notes: This license plate is available to all active members of the Fraternal Order of Police. The fee is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Friends of Hunting Island State Park
plates.displayName: Friends of Hunting Island State Park
plates.baseName: Friends of Hunting Island State Park
plates.notes: The fee for the Hunting Island State Park license plate is $50 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. A portion of the fees collected will go toward the Friends of Hunting Island State Park, Inc. for use on projects benefiting the park.

plates.name: Furman University
plates.notes: Furman University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Gardner-Webb University
plates.notes: Gardner-Webb University license plates are $30 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Funds used for scholarships.

plates.name: Georgia Tech Foundation
plates.notes: Georgia Tech license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee every two years. A portion of the special plate fee will be used for scholarships to Georgia Tech students from South Carolina. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Gold Star Family
plates.notes: The Gold Star Family license plate is available to immediate family members (parent, spouse, sibling or child) of fallen service members as certified by the Affidavit of Relationship on the application form. To apply for the plate, you must present one of the following documents: DD-2064 D.O.D. Certificate of Death (Overseas) or a DD-1300 D.O.D. Report of Casualty. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. There is no cost for this plate. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Gold Star Family, Gold Star Family Motorcycle, and Gold Star Family Personalized. This plate is available by mail only. You may get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability.

plates.name: Gone Fishing
plates.notes: The Saltwater Fishing license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected will be administered by the SC Department of Natural Resources to manage and conserve the marine resources of the state. The fee for this plate is $75 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Heritage Classic Foundation
plates.notes: The Heritage Classic Foundation license plate is available for private passenger vehicles. A portion of the fees collected for the plate go to the Heritage Classic Foundation. The fee is $75 every two years in addition to the regular biennial registration fee. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $75 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: HL Hunley
plates.notes: The license plate commemorates the HL Hunley submarine that sunk off the cost of Sullivan's Island in 1864 and was recovered in 1995. The fee for the plate is $100 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $60, is distributed to the Save the Hunley Fund created by the Hunley Commission or another non-profit fund designated by the commission. The funds provide for the continued curation of the Hunley submarine. This plate is available to anyone interested in the restoration and preservation of the submarine.

plates.name: Homeownership:  The American Dream
plates.notes: The Homeownership: The American Dream license plate is available for all private passenger carrying motor vehicles and light pick-ups having an empty weight of 9,000 lbs. or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 lbs. or less. A portion of the fees collected for this plate is administered by the SC Association of Realtors for distribution to Habitat for Humanity International or another non-profit fund that supports the construction of new homes for low income families. The fee for the plate is $100 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $100 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: In God We Trust
plates.notes: The In God We Trust license plate is available for private passenger vehicles and trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. The requirements and registration fee for this plate is the same as a regular license plate. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: In Reason We Trust
plates.notes: Although Secular Humanist of the Low Country is a membership based organization, the In Reason We Trust license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in additional to the regular registration fee. As a non-profit organization, the Secular Humanists of the Low Country do not receive any portion of the funds generated from the plate sales.

plates.name: Kappa Alpha Psi
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Kappa Alpha Psi plate will be used for academic scholarships. To apply for the plate, you must present a current organizational membership card or a certificate of membership. The fee for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Keep it Beautiful
plates.notes: The Keep South Carolina Beautiful license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected for this plate are distributed to the SC Department of Transportation for the beautification of state highways. The fee for this plate is $54 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Kiwanis International Foundation
plates.notes: The Kiwanis International Foundation license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will be distributed to the Carolinas District Kiwanis Foundation. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Korean Veteran
plates.notes: Korean War Veteran license plate is available to South Carolina residents who served on active duty during the Korean War. You must present a US Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying active duty service during the time period of June 25, 1950 to July 27, 1954, or provide certification of receiving the Korean War Service Medal along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Lander University

This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Legion of Merit

You must present official documentation certifying that you have been awarded the Legion of Merit along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and complete the Surviving Spouse Certification on the application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Legion of Merit and Legion of Merit Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Limestone University

This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Lions International
plates.notes: The Lions International plate is available to all SC residents. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in additional to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Marine Corps

To apply, you must present official documentation certifying that you have been honorably discharged along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Marine Corps plate class to include Marine Corps and Marine Corps Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Marine Corps Distinguished Service Medal and Marine Corps Distinguished Service Medal Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Marine Corps League
plates.notes: You must present a Marine Corps League membership card to apply for this license plate. The fee for this plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee You may be issued three plates.

plates.name: Medal of Honor Air Force

You must present a Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying you have been awarded the Medal of Honor Air Force, along with the completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and must complete Surviving Spouse Certification listed on application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the Medal of Honor Air Force plate class to include Medal of Honor Air Force and Medal of Honor Air Force Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Meritorious Service Medal
plates.notes: The Meritorious Service Medal license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have been awarded the Meritorious Service Medal. You must present a US Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying that you have been awarded the Meritorious Service Medal along with a completed Application for Military Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles, or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Mississippi State
plates.notes: The Mississippi State University license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. Proceeds from the plate will be used to support alumni programs. The cost for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Morris College
plates.notes: Morris College license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Morris Island Lighthouse
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Morris Island Light license plate will be distributed to Save the Light, Inc., or another nonprofit fund designated by Save the Light, Inc., for the restoration and preservation of the Morris Island Lighthouse. The historic Morris Island Lighthouse was built in 1876 and is located off the coast of Folly Beach. The fee for the plate is $100 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Mothers Against Drunk Driving
plates.notes: The fee for the Mothers Against Drunk Driving (MADD) license plate fee is $20 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. The plate is available to the general public and there are no special requirements. A portion of the fees collected will be used to support the efforts of MADD South Carolina.

plates.name: Motorcycle
plates.notes: This license plate is issued to motor vehicles having no more than two permanent functional wheels in contact with the ground or with a detachable side car or trailer and having a saddle for the use of the rider. This excludes tractors.

plates.name: Motorcycle Awareness Alliance
plates.notes: The Motorcycle Awareness Alliance was formed in Anderson, SC to promote safety and awareness to the general driving public. The plate is available for all South Carolina residents for a fee of $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Multiple Sclerosis Society
plates.notes: This license plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. Any customer can buy this plate. There are no special requirements.

plates.name: MUSC
plates.notes: The fee for the Medical University of South Carolina license plate fee is $70 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. The plate is available to the general public and there are no special requirements. A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to the Alumni Association of the Medical University of South Carolina.

plates.name: MUSC Children's Hospital
plates.notes: The fee for the Medical University of South Carolina Children's Hospital license plate is $50 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will be used to provide unit equipment and to support activities for families during their stay at the hospital.

plates.name: NASCAR
plates.notes: The National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing (NASCAR) license plate is available to all South Carolinians. To apply for this plate, complete the Application for Special License Plate (MV-95). The cost is $70 every two years plus the registration fee. Proceeds from this plate will benefit the South Carolina Children's Emergency Shelter Fund, South Carolina Sport's Development Office Fund, and the NASCAR License Plate Highway Safety Fund.

plates.name: National Wild Turkey Federation
plates.notes: A portion of the fees for this license plate will be distributed to National Wild Turkey Federation. The fee is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Navy

The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Navy plate class to include Navy and Navy Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Navy and Marine Corps Medal

You must present a Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying you have been awarded the Navy and Marine Corps Medal, along with the completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and must complete Surviving Spouse Certification listed on application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the Navy and Marine Corps Medal plate class. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Navy Distinguished Service Cross

plates.name: Navy Distinguished Service Medal
plates.notes: The Navy Distinguished Service Medal plate is available to South Carolina residents who have been awarded the Navy Distinguished Service Medal. Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and complete the Surviving Spouse Certification on the application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Navy Distinguished Service Medal and Navy Distinguished Service Medal Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Newberry College

This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: No More Homeless Pets
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for this license plate goes into a special account with the SC Department of Agriculture to support annual spaying and neutering programs. The fee for this plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Normandy Invasion Survivor
plates.notes: The Normandy Invasion Survivor plate is available to customers wo were in the US Military and took part in the Normandy Invasion. Qualifying customers must provide official military documentation demonstrating the applicant was stationed in the European theater between June 6 to August 30, 1944. The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: North Carolina State University
plates.notes: The North Carolina State University license plate is sponsored by the North Carolina State University Alumni Association. Proceeds from the plate will be used to promote the university. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: North Greenville University
plates.notes: North Greenville University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Northwestern High School

The plate is available to the general public and there are no special requirements. A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to the Northwestern High School Trojan Club.

plates.name: Nurses Foundation
plates.notes: The Nurses Foundation license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected are distributed to the South Carolina Nurses Foundation to endow scholarships for all of the state's registered nursing programs. The fee for this plate is $46 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Omega Psi Phi
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Omega Psi Phi license plate will be used for academic scholarships. To apply for the plate, you must present a current organizational membership card, a certificate of membership, or a letter on organizational letterhead that states you are a current member. The fee for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Operation Desert Shield - Desert Storm
plates.notes: The Operation Desert Shield/Desert Storm license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the US Military. To apply, you must present official documentation certifying that you participated in Desert Shield/Desert Storm from January 17 to February 28, 1991 with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Operation Enduring Freedom

The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. plates.name: Operation Iraqi Freedom

The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. plates.name: Our Farms Our Future

A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to the SC Ag in the Classroom Fund to support farm families and promote SC agriculture.

plates.name: Palmetto Cross
plates.notes: South Carolina Palmetto Cross license plates are available to SC residents who are Palmetto Cross recipients. You must complete Application for Military Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37) and must submit a Department of Defense Form DD-214, Palmetto Cross Citation, or a letter from the US, Regional, or County Veterans Administration certifying that you are a recipient of the Palmetto Cross. Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and complete the Surviving Spouse Certification on the application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Palmetto Cross and Palmetto Cross Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Palmetto Health Children's Hospital
plates.notes: The fee for the Palmetto Health Children's Hospital license plate is $40 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will be used to implement new programs and services at the hospital.

plates.name: Parrothead
plates.notes: The Parrothead license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. Proceeds from the plate will be used to support the Palmetto Chapter of the Alzheimer's Association and the Upstate SC Chapter of the Alzheimer's Association. The cost for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Pearl Harbor
plates.notes: The Pearl Harbor license plate is available to South Carolina residents who were a member of the United States Armed Forces on December 7, 1941, were on station on December 7, 1941, during the hours of 7:55 a.m. to 9:45 a.m., Hawaii time at Pearl Harbor, the Island of Oahu, or offshore at a distance not exceeding three miles; and received an honorable discharge from the United States Armed Forces. All applications for Pearl Harbor plates must be verified by the South Carolina State Chairman of Pearl Harbor Survivors. The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Penn Center
plates.notes: The cost if the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Funds collected will go to Penn Center to support its activities.

plates.name: Personalized Disabled Plate
plates.notes: This license plate is available to people who meet the requirements for a plate for a person with a disability and would like to personalize it. First-time applications must be handled by mail using the Application for Personalized Disabled Plate (SCDMV Form MV-96A). The number of letters or numbers are limited to seven. The only symbol you may use is “&”. Blank spaces are counted as one letter or number. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Vehicles with a personalized disabled license plate are exempt from the payment of municipal parking meter fees (SC Code of Laws 56-3-1965) and are allowed to park in designated handicapped parking spaces.

plates.name: Personalized License Plate
plates.notes: First-time applications must be handled by mail using Form MV-96. The number of letters or numbers are limited to seven for motor vehicles and six for motorcycles. The only symbol you may use is" &". No symbols may be used on a motorcycle license plate. Blank spaces are counted as one letter or number. The fee is $30 plus the registration fee.

plates.name: Phi Beta Sigma
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Phi Beta Sigma license plate will be used for academic scholarships. To apply for the plate, you must present an organizational membership card, a certificate of membership, or a letter on organizational letterhead that states you are a current member. The fee for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Play Tennis!
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Play Tennis! license plate go to the South Carolina Tennis Patrons Foundation for scholarships, junior player grants, and programs for at-risk youth. The cost for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees.

plates.name: Powering the Palmetto State
plates.notes: This plate is available to all SC residents. The fee for this plate is $10 in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Presbyterian College
plates.notes: Presbyterian College license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You must use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Prince Hall Masons
plates.notes: The Prince Hall Masons license plate fee is $30 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. To obtain a Prince Hall Masons plate, you must be present a current dues card or a letter on lodge letterhead verifying that you are a Master Mason in good standing. A portion of the fees collected will be used for educational, charitable, and benevolent events sponsored by the Prince Hall Grand Lodge.

plates.name: Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star
plates.displayName: Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star
plates.baseName: Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star
plates.notes: The fee for the Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star license plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. The plate is available to members of the Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star and any Master Mason. You must provide a letter of authorization from the organization at the time of application. Proceeds collected for the license plate will be distributed to Prince Hall Order of the Eastern Star of South Carolina for scholarships.

plates.name: Prisoner of War
plates.notes: To apply for this license plate, you must submit a statement from the US Department of Veterans Affairs certifying that you were a prisoner of war. Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and must complete Surviving Spouse Certification listed on application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. There is no cost for this plate. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Prisoner of War and Prisoner of War Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Protect Wild Dolphins Alliance
plates.notes: The Protect Wild Dolphins license plate is sponsored by Protect Wild Dolphins Alliance Inc. Proceeds from the plate will be used to provide research, conservation, and educational programs to protect wild dolphins. The cost for the plate is $60 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees. This plate is available in field offices and through the mail.

plates.name: Public Education
plates.notes: A portion of the special license plate fee, $40, will be placed in a Public Education: A Great Investment Fund and $34 will be distributed to the school designated for the purchase of computers for use in the classrooms. This plate is issued to light trucks no more than 5,000 lbs. gross vehicle weight. The fee for the plate is $54 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: Purdue University
plates.notes: The Purdue University license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost is $60 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will go to the Purdue University Alumni Association for scholarships for SC residents. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Purple Heart
plates.notes: South Carolina Purple Heart license plates are available to SC residents who are Purple Heart recipients. You must complete Application for Military Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37) and must submit a Department of Defense Form DD-214, Purple Heart Citation, or a letter from the US, Regional, or County Veterans Administration certifying that you are a recipient of the Purple Heart. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. There is no cost for this plate. You may be issued three plates within the plate class to include Purple Heart, Purple Heart Wheelchair, and Purple Heart Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only. To receive handicapped privileges you must be certified permanently handicapped by a licensed physician on the Disabled License Plate and Placard Application (SCDMV Form RG-007A)

plates.name: Quality Deer Management
plates.notes: The Quality Deer Management Association license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost of the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will be used to support the association's mission and projects at the state and local level in SC.

plates.name: Reduce Reuse Recycle
plates.notes: The Reduce Reuse Recycle license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost of the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will support the SC Recycling Industry, provide education and increase awareness of recycling in the state.

plates.name: Respiratory Therapy
plates.notes: Respiratory Therapy license plates are $25 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee will be used for South Carolina Society for Respiratory Care activities, education, scholarships and events. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Retired National Guard
plates.notes: The Retired National Guard license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the Retired National Guard. To apply, you must present official documentation certifying that you have been honorably discharged along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Retired National Guard plate class to include Retired National Guard and Retired National Guard Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Riverbanks Zoo & Garden
plates.notes: Join the Flock! Support the Zoo and save endangered animals and their habitats. The plate is available for all South Carolina residents for a fee of $50 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
plates.notes: The Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost of the plate is $50 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will be used to support wildlife conservation and hunting heritage.

plates.name: Ronald McDonald House Charities
plates.notes: Ronald McDonald House Charities sponsor this license plate. Proceeds from the plate will be used to provide housing for the families of critically ill children. The cost for the plate is $50 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Rotary International
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for this license plate will be deposited to an account designated by each South Carolina Rotary District and be distributed properly be each district. The fee for this plate is $50 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: SC Ancient Free and Accepted Masons
plates.displayName: SC Ancient Free and Accepted Masons
plates.baseName: SC Ancient Free and Accepted Masons
plates.notes: To apply for a South Carolina Ancient Free and Accepted Masons license plate, you must present a current dues card from a Masonic Lodge or a letter from a Masonic Lodge Secretary authorizing an honorary member or any person duly authorized by that officer to purchase a plate. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: SC Aviation Association- Hall of Fame
plates.displayName: SC Aviation Association- Hall of Fame
plates.baseName: SC Aviation Association- Hall of Fame

You must present a letter from the SC Aviation Association's Director indicating induction into the Hall of Fame and qualifying applicant to purchase plate along with a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV MV-95). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: SC Cattlemen's Association
plates.notes: The South Carolina Cattlemen's Association plate is available to all SC residents. Proceeds from the plate will be used for scholarships and research. The cost for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: SC Chiropractic Association
plates.notes: To apply for a South Carolina Chiropractic Association license plate, you must present a membership letter on organizational letterhead that states you are a member of the organization. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in additional to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: SC Concerns of Police Survivors
plates.notes: SC Concerns of Police Survivors honor the lives of fallen officers. The license plate is $25 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Funds to assist law enforcement survivors. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $25 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: SC Elks Foundation
plates.notes: The South Carolina Elks Association license plate does not require a membership and is available to all SC residents. A portion of the fees collected for the plate will be used to support the SC Elk's Association's Alzheimer's state project. The fee is $30 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: SC Equality
plates.notes: The South Carolina Equality license plate is available to all SC residents. The fee is $25 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Fees from the sale of the plate will be distributed to SC Equality for education and advocacy for the SC GLBT community.

plates.name: SC Sheriffs' Association
plates.notes: The South Carolina Sheriff’s Association license plate is sponsored by the South Carolina Sheriff’s Association. Proceeds from the plate will be used to provide support and training services to the 46 sheriffs of South Carolina. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCMDV Form MV-95) along with the required fees. This plate is available in field offices and through the mail.

plates.name: SC Stands With Israel
plates.notes: The South Carolina Stands with Israel license plate does not require a membership and is available to all SC residents. A portion of the fees collected for the plate will be distributed to Chabad of Charleston and will be used to support charities that show support for Israel. The fee is $20 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: SC State University
plates.notes: South Carolina State University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, will be sent to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $70 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: SC Troopers Association
plates.notes: The South Carolina Troopers Association license plate is available to SCTA members in good standing. To apply for the plate, you must present a Letter of Authorization from SCTA. There is no special fee for the plate other than the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Shag
plates.notes: There are no special requirements for the Shag license plate. The fee is $50 plus the registration fee.

plates.name: Share the Road
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for this license plate go to the Palmetto Cycling Coalition, Inc. or another non-profit organization designated by the Palmetto Cycling Coalition for the promotion of bicycling safety and education programs. Although the Palmetto Cycling Coalition is a membership-based organization, the plates are available to all South Carolina residents. The cost for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees.

plates.name: Sherman College of Chiropractic
plates.notes: Sherman College of Chiropractic license plate is sponsored by Sherman College. The proceeds will be used to provide scholarships to South Carolina students who attend Sherman College. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees. It can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. This plate is available through the mail and online. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalized fee and $70 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: Shriners
plates.notes: You must present a statement from your Shriners group, dues card, or any other official document verifying you are a Shriner. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: Sigma Gamma Rho
plates.notes: This license plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. You must certify membership with a membership card or a certificate of membership.

plates.name: Silver Star
plates.notes: The Silver Star license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have been awarded the Silver Star Medal. You must present a Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying that you have been awarded the Silver Star Medal along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and must complete Surviving Spouse Certification listed on application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may obtain 3 plates within the plate class to include Silver Star and Silver Star Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Soldier's Medal
plates.notes: This license plate is available to South Carolina Residents who have been awarded the Soldier's Medal. You must present a Department of Defense Form DD-214 or other official documentation certifying you have been awarded the Soldier's Medal, along with the completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). Surviving spouse may obtain a new plate in their name if not remarried and must complete Surviving Spouse Certification listed on application. This plate allows free parking at municipal parking meters. This plate is exempt from fees. You may be issued three plates within the Soldier's Medal plate class to include Soldier's Medal and Soldier's Medal Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Sons of Confederate Veterans
plates.notes: This license plate is for members only. A portion of the fees collected from this plate will be distributed to the South Carolina Sons of Confederate Veterans. The fee is $30 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Southern Wesleyan University

This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Space Force

The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Space Force plate class to include Space Force and Space Force Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Spartanburg Community College
plates.notes: Spartanburg Community College license plate is sponsored by Spartanburg Community College Foundation. The proceeds will be used to provide scholarships to South Carolina students who attend Spartanburg Community College. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees. It can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. This plate is available through the mail and online.

plates.name: Special Olympics
plates.notes: There are no special requirements for this license plate. A portion of this fee will be deposited into a Special Olympic Fund. The fee for the plate is $50 every two years in addition to the registration fee.

plates.name: Square Dance
plates.notes: There are no special requirements for this license plate. The fee is $50.00 plus the registration fee.

plates.name: St. Jude
plates.notes: South Carolina "Finding Cures. Saving Children" plates are available to all SC residents. The fee is $40 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to St. Jude’s Children's Research Hospital.

plates.name: State Guard
plates.notes: The State Guard license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the State Guard. To apply, you must present official documentation certifying that you have been honorably discharged along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the State Guard plate class to include State Guard and State Guard Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Support Our Troops
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for the Support Our Troops license plate will be distributed to SupportOurTroops.org, a nonpartisan patriotic civilian-led organization 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization which promotes support for and bolsters deployed troops (our neighbors) and their families, including care packages, morale and assistance, and special events. The fee for the plate is $30.00 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Surfrider Foundation
plates.notes: This license plate fee is $65 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. Funds from the $65 plate fee are distributed to Surfrider Foundation. Funds will be used for environmental projects and education. Anyone may buy this plate. There are no special requirements.

plates.name: Technology Alliance
plates.notes: A portion of the fees collected for this license plate will be distributed to the South Carolina Technology Alliance for the continued development of high technology programs across the state and to provide resources for SC Technology Entrepreneurs. The fee for the special plate is $100 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: The Citadel

You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for these plates. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: The Ohio State University
plates.notes: The Ohio State University Alumni Association sponsors the Ohio State University license plate. Proceeds from the plate will be used for scholarships. The cost for the plate is $40 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Tree My Dog
plates.notes: The Tree My Dog license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected are distributed to the South Carolina Coon Hunters Association Youth Fund. The fee for this plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular vehicle registration fee.

plates.name: Trees SC
plates.notes: The Trees South Carolina license plate is available to all SC residents. The cost of the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will support community forestry programs in the state.

plates.name: Trout Unlimited INC.
plates.notes: The Trout Unlimited plate is available to all South Carolina residents. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. Proceeds from this plate will be used for cold-water conservation efforts.

plates.name: U.S. Submarine Veterans
plates.notes: U.S. Submarine Veterans license plate is available to active or veteran U.S. Submarine Sailors. You must submit a completed Application for Military Plates (SCDMV Form MV-37) and official military documentation. The cost for the plate is $20 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will be distributed to the South Carolina Submarine Scholarships Program. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: United We Stand
plates.notes: The United We Stand license plate honors the victims who lost their lives in the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. The fee for the plate is $25 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. Fees collected for this plate will be distributed to the national 'Rewards For Justice' fund which was created to establish rewards for the capture of terrorists. This plate is available to anyone interested in commemorating September 11th and supporting our nation's efforts to combat terrorism.

plates.name: University of Alabama

This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: US Air Force Academy
plates.notes: The US Air Force Academy license plate is sponsored by the Association of Graduates of the US Air Force Academy. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: US Armed Forces Retired
plates.notes: You must provide a Department of Defense Form DD-214, Retirement Order, copy of military ID reflecting retired status, or other verification that applicant is a retired member of the US Armed Forces. The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Armed Forces Retired plate class to include Armed Forces Retired and Armed Forces Retired Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: US Army Reserve
plates.notes: The US Army Reserve license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the Army Reserves. To apply, you must present an Active Reserve Military ID along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Army Reserve plate class to include Army Reserve and Army Reserve Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: US Coast Guard Reserve
plates.notes: The US Coast Guard Reserve license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the Coast Guard Reserves. plates.name: US Marine Corps Reserve

plates.notes: The US Navy Chief Petty Officer license plate is available to active or retired US Navy Chief Petty Officers. You must submit a completed Application for Military Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is $60 every two years plus the regular registration fee. Proceeds from the sale of this plate will be distributed to the Patriots Point Foundation and be used to preserve the heritage of the ships and displays of the Patriots Point Naval and Maritime Museum in Charleston Harbor. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: US Navy Reserve
plates.notes: The US Navy Reserve license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served or currently serving active duty in the Navy Reserves. To apply, you must present an Active Reserve Military ID along with a completed Application for Military License Plate (SCDMV Form MV-37). The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. You may be issued three plates within the Navy Reserve plate class to include Navy Reserve and Navy Reserve Motorcycle. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: USC Association of Letterman
plates.notes: The University of South Carolina Association of Lettermen license plates are $60 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. The plate is available to South Carolina residents who are members of the Association. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the "&" symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $60 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: USC Baseball National Champions
plates.notes: The University of South Carolina Baseball National Champions license plate is sponsored by My Carolina Alumni Association. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will be distributed to USC for scholarships. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: USC NCAAW 3x National Champions
plates.notes: The University of South Carolina Women's Basketball 3x National Champions license plate is sponsored by USC Alumni Association. A portion of the fees collected for this plate will be distributed to USC for scholarships. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: USC Upstate
plates.notes: The USC Upstate license plate proceeds will be used to provide scholarships to South Carolina students who attend USC Upstate. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees. This plate is available through the mail and online.

plates.name: Veteran
plates.notes: The Veteran license plate is available to South Carolina residents who have served in the United States Armed Forces active or reserved components. To apply for the plate, you must present your Department of Defense Form DD-214, indicating that you were honorably discharged, along with a completed Application for Military Plate (MV-37). Only three plates within the Veteran plate class to include Veteran, Veteran Motorcycle and Veteran Wheelchair may be issued to vehicles registered in your name. The cost for this plate is the regular registration fee. To receive the handicapped privileges , you must be certified permanently handicapped by a licensed physician on the Disabled License Plate and Placard Application (SCDMV Form RG-007A).

plates.name: Vietnam Veteran
plates.notes: You must present a Department of Defense Form DD-214 or documentation certifying that you were awarded the Vietnam Service Medal or that you served on active duty in Vietnam. The plate is only available to Vietnam War veterans who served on active duty during the period of February 28, 1961 to May 7, 1975. The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: Virginia Tech
plates.notes: The Virginia Tech license plate is sponsored by the Virginia Tech Alumni Association. Proceeds from the plate will be used for scholarships. The cost for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular registration fees. You must submit a completed Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) along with required fees.

plates.name: Volunteer Firefighter
plates.notes: Issued to members of SC Volunteer Fire Unit. Must be authorized by Chief Officer of the Fire Unit.

plates.name: Voorhees College
plates.notes: Voorhees College license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for these plates. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: West Point
plates.notes: To apply for the West Point license plate, you must present a current organizational membership card or a letter on organizational letterhead that states you are a current member. The fee for the plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. As a non-profit organization, West Point does not receive any portion of the funds generated from the license plate sales.

plates.name: West Virginia University
plates.notes: West Virginia University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Wildlife Deer
plates.notes: The Wildlife Deer license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected for this plate is distributed to the SC Department of Natural Resources Game Fund. The fee for this plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Wildlife Painted Bunting
plates.notes: The Wildlife Painted Bunting license plate is available to all South Carolina residents. A portion of the fees collected for this plate is distributed to the SC Department of Natural Resources Game Fund. The fee for this plate is $30 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee.

plates.name: Wilson High School
plates.notes: The fee for the Wilson High School license plate fee is $70 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. The plate is available to the general public and there are no special requirements for acquiring the plate. A portion of the fees collected will be distributed to the Wilson High School Alumni Association.

plates.name: Winthrop University
plates.notes: Winthrop University license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: Wofford College
plates.notes: Wofford College license plates are $70 every two years in addition to the registration fee. A portion of the special plate fee, $40, goes to the school for scholarships. You may use the Application for Special Plate (SCDMV Form MV-95) to apply for this plate. This plate can be purchased for cars or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less.

plates.name: World War II
plates.notes: The World War II license plate is available to all World War II veterans. You must provide official documentation of your World War II service. The cost for the plate is the regular registration fee. This plate can be purchased for cars, motorcycles or light trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. You may be issued three plates. This plate is available by mail only.

plates.name: www.IBELIEVEsc.net
plates.notes: The www.IBelieveSC.net license plate is available for private passenger vehicles and trucks with an empty weight of 9,000 pounds or less and a gross vehicle weight of 11,000 pounds or less. The biennial fee for the plate is $25 every two years in addition to the regular registration fee. Proceeds from the sale of this plate are used to support faith-based educational and religious programs. You may also get a personalized version of the plate that contains letters or numbers or both and the “&” symbol. Text is limited to six characters including spaces and will be granted based on availability. The personalized version of this plate is available by mail in only. The fee to get this plate personalized includes $30 personalization fee and $25 special plate fee in addition to regular registration fee.

plates.name: Zeta Phi Beta
plates.notes: The Zeta Phi Beta license plate is available to all South Carolina Residents who are members of the Zeta Phi Beta Sorority. You must present a membership card or a letter from the state director to be eligible. The fee for the plate is $70 every two years in addition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee. A portion of the fees collected will be used by Zeta Phi Beta for academic scholarships.
